identitySignals: Agenda names "Moka Engineering Construction, Inc., Santa Clara, CA" as the contractor for the Prescott Elementary School site improvement project. A California Secretary of State-derived record (BizProfile) lists "Moka Engineering And Construction LLC" in Santa Clara, CA. The city matches.

Business directories and a school-district approved-contractor list show a general contractor named Moka Engineering and Construction at 3315 Montgomery Dr., Unit 312, Santa Clara, which fits OUSD's construction-services contract.
Mismatch: the agenda says "Inc." but the registry entity found is an LLC. I could not confirm they are the same legal entity, or whether a separate corporation exists.
research.notes: Not publishable. The agenda says "Moka Engineering Construction, Inc.", but the only registry record found is for "Moka Engineering And Construction LLC" (CA entity 202027910050, a Texas-formed LLC). They may be the same business with the agenda naming it loosely, or a separate entity. I did not verify this on the California Secretary of State site itself. The CSLB license (#1079408) was listed under the LLC name on BuildZoom, which I did not fetch. A likely website, mokaconstruction.com, appeared only in search snippets and I could not fetch it, so website, phone and email are left null. No EIN or SAM UEI was found. A human reviewer should check the entity name on the CSLB or Secretary of State site and the OUSD contract before publishing.
